next.reason: 1985: data-name-2's value 'at the time an OPEN statement with the OUTPUT phrase is executed' defines the first page's footing area, and at a WRITE with ADVANCING PAGE or a page overflow the next page's. §2023:13.18.34.4 GR6 b) takes the footing start from the data item 'At the completion of an OPEN statement with the OUTPUT phrase', during a WRITE with ADVANCING PAGE and during a page-overflow WRITE, for the next logical page. Same timing. GR3 (what the footing value means) is 1985 GR3's requirement, and the EC-I-O-LINAGE check carries its limits.
